summary: The filing reports a routine annual meeting outcome where shareholders approved a charter amendment, resulting in the automatic conversion of convertible debentures into Series B Convertible Preferred Stock. The conversion of a $6.8 million note plus interest issued 6,841 shares of preferred stock. No premium, price per share, or other deal terms were provided, as this is a contractual conversion, not a new transaction. The event is not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activist or strategic change. It reflects a pre-existing financing structure with no unusual catalyst or break fee.
